:::{#def-convex-function}
#### Convex function

Let $f : \reals^p \to \reals$ be a [function](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/functions.html#def-function).
$f$ is **convex**
[@wikipedia_convex_function]
if
$$
f(t x + (1 - t) y) \le t f(x) + (1 - t) f(y)
$$
for all $x, y \in \reals^p$ and all $t \in [0, 1]$.

:::
